name: Carenet Health (Office or Home)
assessment: After applying, expect a 30-minute skills assessment. This is followed by an AI-conducted interview, then a hiring event interview with a recruiter via Zoom. Assessments must be completed independently. The full process takes approximately two weeks.
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: High school diploma or GED required.
 Required Experience: At least six months of experience in a healthcare contact center, patient access, or customer service environment preferred. Hands-on scheduling experience within a healthcare organization, preferably supporting diagnostic imaging or specialty care, is required.
 Preferred Experience: Multi-department or specialty scheduling background. Radiology-specific scheduling experience.
 Required Skills:
Typing speed of at least 40 WPM
Strong verbal communication with demonstrated empathy and professional telephone etiquette
Ability to manage multiple systems simultaneously in a fast-paced environment
Strong attention to detail and ability to follow established protocols
Basic computer proficiency including Windows, Outlook, Teams, and CRM or scheduling platforms
Required work from home experience in a private, secure, distraction-free environment
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone with healthcare scheduling, patient access, or medical office experience who is comfortable managing high call volume
Participants who are organized, detail-oriented, and can learn and retain a wide range of scheduling protocols across multiple imaging service lines
People who are comfortable working in a strictly monitored, metrics-driven remote environment
Anyone who already owns two monitors and meets the home setup requirements before applying
Not a Good Fit for:
Participants without at least some healthcare scheduling or patient access background. The experience requirement is real and specific
Anyone who needs flexibility or leniency around break times and schedule adherence. This role is closely monitored
Participants who do not own two monitors and cannot obtain them before the start date
Anyone who needs the hiring process to move quickly, since this process takes approximately two weeks with multiple assessment steps
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Radiology scheduling
Diagnostic imaging coordination
Patient appointment scheduling
Healthcare contact center
Multi-modality scheduling
Insurance verification
HIPAA compliance
CRM documentation
Inbound patient calls
Patient access
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 After applying, you will receive an immediate response with a link to a 30-minute skills assessment. Complete it promptly. A second assessment follows three to four days later, which is an AI-conducted question and answer interview. After that, you will be invited to schedule a hiring event interview conducted via Zoom with a recruiter. The full process takes approximately two weeks from application to offer. Confirm your internet provider and connection type meets requirements before scheduling the Zoom interview, since internet compatibility is verified during the hiring event and can end the process on the spot if your provider is not accepted.
Likely interview questions for this role:
Tell me about your experience scheduling medical appointments and what types of appointments or service lines you handled.
How do you stay organized when scheduling across multiple service lines with different protocols and preparation requirements?
Describe how you handle a patient who is anxious or confused about their upcoming imaging appointment.
How do you manage navigating multiple computer systems at the same time while actively talking with a patient?
other:
Confirm the participant's internet provider meets Carenet's requirements before they invest time in the two-week hiring process. Multiple candidates have been disqualified at the final Zoom interview stage because their internet provider was not accepted, after already completing two assessments and waiting nearly two weeks. This is a hard stop and it is not disclosed upfront in the posting.

The two-monitor requirement is real and confirmed by employee accounts. Participants who do not own two monitors need to have a plan for obtaining them before the August 6th start date.

This role operates under close performance monitoring. Break timing is tracked to the minute and occurrences are issued for even a one-minute late return. Participants who need some flexibility in their daily routine should understand this environment before applying.
The start date is August 6, 2026, which means the hiring process needs to move immediately.
Career Pathway: Radiology Scheduler → Senior Scheduler → Scheduling Team Lead → Patient Access Supervisor → Patient Services Manager
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
